lines.t: This game is 11 years old, and it just broke its own player record.
The Witcher 3 Remastered launched on September 29th and hit almost 121,000 players at once on Steam.
It adds path-traced lighting, reworked combat animations and a new skill tree.
And if you already own the game, the upgrade is free.
You play Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter for hire, searching for his adopted daughter, Ciri.
It has sold over 65 million copies and won more than 250 game of the year awards.
The script is 450,000 words long, with 950 speaking roles.
The author of the books, Andrzej Sapkowski, sold the game rights for about 9,500 dollars, and turned down a share of the profits.

sc.label: Game rights sold for
sc.sub: the author refused a profit share

lines.t: When the Netflix show came out, sales jumped by 554 percent.
Its card game, Gwent, got so popular that it became its own standalone game.

sc.sub: the mini-game that became a game

lines.t: The remaster finally fixed Roach, the glitchy horse. But there is reportedly a setting to keep the glitches.

sc.sub: a setting to keep the glitches

lines.t: A new expansion arrives in 2027, and The Witcher 4 won't be here before 2028.
Be honest: the story, or just Gwent? Follow for more!
